info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Knowledge Asset By Param1-spec
info.description: This API enables users to access specific knowledge assets by a unique parameter, providing targeted information retrieval. Users can utilize this endpoint to query for management manuals and other critical resources essential for informed decision-making. Typical consumers of this API include banking professionals, compliance officers, and operational managers seeking quick access to up-to-date procedural documents. The service enhances operational efficiency by streamlining access to essential knowledge assets, thereby supporting regulatory compliance and best practice implementation.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific management manual by its ID.
get.description: This operation fetches the details of a management manual identified by the resource ID provided in the request path. It allows users to access relevant information about the management manual for review or further actions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch the management manual resource identified by RES-100045. It should be constructed according to the specified schema to ensure the correct extraction of data pertaining to the management manual.

200.description: The request was successful, and the requested data is returned.

GetKnowledgeAssetByParam1Request.description: A JSON string representing the request body for GET operations related to the management manual in knowledge assets.

GetKnowledgeAssetByParam1Response_200.title: Management Manual Response Schema

manualId.description: Unique identifier for the management manual.

ownerId.description: Identifier for the owner of the management manual.

effectiveDate.description: Date indicating when the management manual becomes effective.

classification.description: Classification level of the management manual.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the management manual.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the management manual response.
